chunks: The Children of Israel, when they offered the sacrifice, a fire would come forth and consume the sacrifice of the one from whom it was accepted; and Allah, Blessed and Exalted, made ihram in place of the sacrifice.

key_terms.الْإِحْرَامَ: The consecrated state for hajj or 'umrah appointed in place of the former offering
key_terms.الْقُرْبَانَ: The sacrificial offering presented for divine acceptance
key_terms.بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ: The Children of Israel, the earlier community being referenced
key_terms.نَارٌ: A fire that would consume the accepted offering

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith explain ihram as replacing the sacrificial offering of the Children of Israel?
ai.summary: This hadith states that among the Children of Israel, acceptance of an offering was shown when fire consumed it. It then explains that Allah, Blessed and Exalted, appointed ihram as the corresponding act in this Ummah in place of that former sacrificial sign.
